headline: Tesla Reports Lower Q3 Profit as R&D Spending Rises and Deliveries Fall
summary: Tesla posted a third-quarter net income drop of 44% to $787 million alongside slightly lower car sales, increased R&D spending, and a decline in regulatory credit revenue.
why: Tesla is a leading electric vehicle and clean energy manufacturer whose profitability depends heavily on vehicle delivery volumes and energy storage deployment.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Falling quarterly profits and lower vehicle sales highlighted margin pressures despite strong long-term targets.

why_moved: A steep 44% drop in quarterly profit and softer vehicle deliveries disappointed investors seeking earnings growth.
